en: An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural valley landscape with rolling hills and scattered wooden houses or cabins. A tree and grassy slope are in the foreground; in the middle distance a curved dirt road and fenced fields lead to a small settlement of low buildings nestled in the valley. The right side of the card is largely blank, likely reserved for writing. Russian text is printed along the top.
